double-negation: NOT NOT X
We want to show that this expression has the same value as X. We will rewrite it using the laws above.
NOT NOT X = (NOT NOT X) AND 1

Identity says Y AND 1 = Y for any Boolean value Y. Put NOT NOT X in both places occupied by Y, then read the equality from right to left. We have only added AND 1; we have not assumed that NOT NOT X = X.
NOT NOT X = (NOT NOT X) AND (X OR NOT X)
In line 2, replace 1 by X OR NOT X (complementation, right to left).

NOT NOT X = ((NOT NOT X) AND X) OR
((NOT NOT X) AND NOT X)
Distributivity in line 3.
NOT NOT X = ((NOT NOT X) AND X) OR 0
In line 4, use complementation with Y = NOT X: Y AND NOT Y = 0. The two factors are in the opposite order, so use commutativity too.
NOT NOT X = (NOT NOT X) AND X
Identity in line 5. Keep this equality.
X = X AND 1
Now rewrite X using Identity, X = X AND 1. We will reach the expression saved in line 6.

X = X AND
((NOT NOT X) OR NOT X)
In line 7, use complementation with Y = NOT X: Y OR NOT Y = 1. Read it right to left and swap the two terms to replace 1 by (NOT NOT X) OR NOT X.

X = (X AND NOT NOT X) OR
(X AND NOT X)
Distributivity in line 8.
X = (X AND NOT NOT X) OR 0
In line 9, replace X AND NOT X by 0 (complementation).
X = X AND NOT NOT X
Identity in line 10.
X = (NOT NOT X) AND X
Commutativity in line 11.
NOT NOT X = X
Lines 6 and 12 have the same right-hand side. Symmetry and transitivity give the result.
